scope: Local synthetic rebuild; original repository and audit remain read-only.

verdicts.PASS: Every required check for the named scope ran and passed, with current evidence and prerequisites.
verdicts.FAIL: At least one required measured check failed; successful retries do not erase the original failure.
verdicts.INCOMPLETE: Required evidence, dependency, observation, independent cases or human acceptance is missing; never promoted to PASS.
verdicts.ERROR: The runner, input, tool or evidence processing failed; no product success claim is possible.

precedence: For valid evaluable evidence, FAIL precedes INCOMPLETE, and PASS requires neither. ERROR denotes inability to evaluate, not a product-quality score.

browser_or_live_integration.availability_failure: INCOMPLETE if prerequisite absent; FAIL if an expected recovery scenario violates its contract. Record original runner error separately.

product_acceptance.category_C_requires: Expected refusal with correct behavior and reason for every case; no averaging away critical failures.
requires: SME evidence for exact case set

coverage.purpose: Diagnostic identification of unexecuted lines and branches in critical modules, not model-quality evidence.

owners.qa_automation: Functional controls, fixtures, reproducible runners and evidence integrity
owners.model_evaluation: Observed retrieval/model metrics, repeatability and judge calibration reports
owners.operator: Usability, manual review and measured report acceptance
owners.aml_expert: Domain labels, policy/interpretation and SME acceptance
owners.project_owner: Commits/push, remote CI evidence and scope decisions

source_of_thresholds: src/evaluation/gates.py; stricter supported runtime settings retain precedence
future_profile_implementation: Not implemented by this strategy file; existing evaluator behavior is unchanged.
